## Adversarial findings — not obtained (backend authentication failed)

The only backend, `openai/fixture-model` (chain[0]), rejected the request with HTTP 401 (fixture authentication failure), and the review helper exited 7. Retrying with the same credentials is pointless, and a credentials fault must not quietly switch off the second opinion. So this goes to a human to fix the backend's API key, then the review re-runs.
